details: This package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web API library that covertly modifies the connecting user's WhatsApp account. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js, makeNewsletterSocket — invoked unconditionally from lib/Socket/messages-send.js for every client socket — schedules two 90000 ms timers; each issues a WhatsApp w:mex FOLLOW query (QueryIds.FOLLOW) for a newsletter JID stored base64-encoded in the source, followed by a second nested follow 5 seconds later. The four hardcoded channels are 120363425000320171@newsletter, 120363420757607688@newsletter, 120363400738305381@newsletter and 120363423837510800@newsletter, and every call is wrapped in an empty catch so no error or log surfaces. The fork also stamps messages generated through the library with forwarded-newsletter attribution to 120363420757607688@newsletter ("7eppeli - Information") in lib/Utils/messages.js, and lib/Socket/luxu.js hardcodes 120363421563597486@newsletter and 120363399602691477@newsletter for the same purpose. Additionally lib/Utils/generics.js fetches version data from hxxps://raw.githubusercontent[.]com/kiuur/bails/master/src/Defaults/baileys-version.json. The obfuscation (base64 JIDs, 90-second delays, silent failures) exists specifically to hide the account modification; the preinstall file engine-requirements.js only checks the Node.js major version.
